voice.name: Open Sector - Supply Truck
voice.description: Cheerful chatty male quartermaster truck driver in his thirties, bright friendly tenor with a lively urban accent, always talking, upbeat and a bit of a hustler, sounds like he is grinning while leaning out the cab window, treats ammo crates like he is delivering pastries.
voice.sample: Morning, morning! Supply truck, fresh ammo, hot off the line! Who ordered the shells? Sign here, here, and here. Oh, and mind the mine there, I'll take care of that little fella for you, no charge.

move.prompt: Modern military truck engine starting and revving, gears crunching, pulling away on dirt road, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Light truck explodes, ammunition crates popping and cracking in fire, glass and metal debris, medium distance, no music, no voice

special.prompt: Wooden ammunition crates unloaded from a truck bed, heavy clanking boxes set down, metal ammo belts and shells rattling, tailgate clank, close, no music, no voice
